blocks.content:
Pangaea → Laurasia + Gondwanaland
Lithosphere over asthenosphere
Divergent → new crust
Convergent → subduction
Transform → earthquakes

items: Divergent boundaries construct new crust, whereas convergent boundaries involve subduction.
Transform boundaries are distinctly associated with causing earthquakes.
Pangaea divided into Laurasia and Gondwanaland.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Pangaea originally split into two major landmasses: Laurasia and Gondwanaland.
The rigid lithosphere lies directly over the semi-fluid asthenosphere.
Divergent plate movements lead to the creation of new crust.
Convergent plate movements result in subduction processes.
Transform boundary interactions generate seismic activity resulting in earthquakes.
